body: Forward test of the management-tone-vs-delivery method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.42 (naive base rate 0.50) that: Sona BLW (Sona Comstar) Q3 FY27 consolidated operating margin is ≥23.0%. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (Oct-2026): EBITDA margin 23%, down 2.3 pts YoY; H1 EBITDA +34% to ₹659 cr. Mgmt keeps 23–25% range ('I do not see any reason to change that range') while describing 'exceptional inflation… In my career, I've not seen inflation like this'; mix shift to lower-margin motor controllers. Screener OPM: Sep-25 25%, Dec-25 25%, Mar-26 24%, Jun-26 23%, Sep-26 23%; sales +52%/+35% YoY. Reasoning: Two quarters sit exactly at the range floor with a down-drift, rising low-margin mix and self-described extreme inflation. Reassurance without a mechanism ('ghee shakkar') = tone test; we lean below the floor. Resolution: YES if Q3 FY27 consolidated Operating Profit ÷ Sales on screener.in ≥23.0% (company-reported EBITDA margin used if screener unavailable). Source: screener.in Sona BLW consolidated quarterly results; company Q3 FY27 press release. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs base rate.
